<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Five people are killed in two separate attacks targeting [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] employees in [[Kabul]], including the head of the [[provinces of Afghanistan|provincial]] department of the [[Ministry of Rural Rehabilitation and Development]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks/five-killed-in-kabul-as-attacks-increasingly-target-civilians-idUSKBN2A91HC?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[Tatmadaw]] raids the [[headquarters]] of ousted de facto leader [[Aung San Suu Kyi]]'s party [[National League for Democracy]] in [[Yangon]], according to a party statement posted on [[Facebook]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/myanmar-military-raids-aung-san-suu-kyi-s-party-offices-as-un-14148556 (CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020 Calabasas helicopter crash]]
**The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] concludes their investigation of the crash that killed former professional basketball player [[Kobe Bryant]] and eight others nearly a year prior, citing [[pilot error]] and [[spatial disorientation]] as the cause of the crash. [https://apnews.com/article/kobe-bryant-helicopter-crash-cause-2c87b04d28961fd277927eea8e8e5564 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Manitoba]]
*****[[Manitoba]] reports its first case of the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|UK variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba/covid-19-uk-coronavirus-variant-b117-manitoba-1.5907009 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports its first two cases of the [[501.V2 variant]] first detected in [[South Africa]] in [[Abitibi-Témiscamingue]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7629470/quebec-reports-first-two-cases-of-covid-19-south-african-variant/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration]] grants [[emergency use authorization]] for [[Eli Lilly and Company]]'s combination antibody therapy [[bamlanivimab/etesevimab]] for use in COVID-19 positive adults and children aged 12 and older who are at high risk of severe disease. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-10/lilly-covid-antibody-combo-gets-u-s-emergency-use-authorization (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care|Health Secretary]] [[Matt Hancock]] announces that all British and Irish residents returning from 33 "high-risk" countries will be charged £1,750 to stay in quarantine hotels in [[England]] for 10 days and that those who fail to do so or who violate COVID rules face fines of up to £10,000 or up to 10 years in jail. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-55995645 (BBC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****Scottish Transport secretary [[Michael Matheson (politician)|Michael Matheson]] announces that all people who arrive from outside the [[United Kingdom|UK]] and [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] will be charged £1,750 for “managed quarantine” at one of six hotels at [[Aberdeen]], [[Edinburgh]] and [[Glasgow]] airports. [https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/scotland-covid-hotel-quarantine-arrival-b1799754.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Chancellor of Austria|Chancellor]] [[Sebastian Kurz]] announces a statewide isolation order in [[Tyrol (state)|Tyrol]] beginning February 12 in order to prevent the spread of the [[501.V2 variant]]. Residents will have to present a negative [[COVID-19 test]] result from the last 48 hours in order to leave the state. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/austria-restrict-movement-tyrol-variant-fears-75777121 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
****[[Belarus]] surpasses 260,000 cases of COVID-19 after reporting 561 new cases in the past 24 hours. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/europe/2021-02/09/c_139733562.htm (Xinhua)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] announces a near-full [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in the [[Attica (region)|Attica region]], which includes the capital [[Athens]], from February 11 until February 28. All schools, churches, hair salons, and retail stores, with the exception of supermarkets and pharmacies, are ordered to close; and restaurants are only allowed to offer delivery services. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/262195/article/ekathimerini/news/attica-to-enter-two-week-hard-lockdown-amid-rise-in-hospitalizations (Ekathimerini)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] surpasses three million cases of COVID-19. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-02-spain-tops-million-virus-cases.html (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]]
****[[Switzerland]] reports its first case of the [[Brazil]]ian P.7 variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.thelocal.ch/20210209/switzerland-records-first-case-of-brazilian-coronavirus-mutation (''The Local Switzerland'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] among [[healthcare workers]] using the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/9/iran-starts-covid-vaccinations-with-sputnik-v (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] approves the emergency use of [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://sputnikvaccine.com/newsroom/pressreleases/mongolia-approves-the-use-of-sputnik-v/ (Sputnik V)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****The [[Government of Malaysia|government]] allows more businesses in retail sector and [[Mosque]]s in most of [[Malaysia]] to reopen beginning tomorrow and allows restaurants to resume dine-in service with two people seat on the table despite [[COVID-19]] cases in the country remains high. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-allows-more-businesses-to-reopen-including-dine-ins-at-restaurants (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] approves the emergency use of [[Russia]]'s Sputnik V [[vaccine]], becoming the third vaccine to be approved in the country after the [[Sinopharm]] and [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-pakistan-vaccine/pakistan-approves-russias-sputnik-v-covid-19-vaccine-for-emergency-use-idUSKBN2A90WE (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Equatorial Guinea]]
***[[Equatorial Guinea]] imposes a curfew from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. local time for the first since the beginning of the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]] and prohibits many leisure activities. The country also reduces domestic flights to once per day, and international flights to twice per week for domestic airlines and once per week for foreign airlines. [https://ewn.co.za/2021/02/09/equatorial-guinea-imposes-curfew-as-virus-rebounds/amp (EWN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
***[[Peru]] launches a vaccination program against COVID-19 two days after it received 300,000 doses of [[Sinopharm]]'s [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine. [[President of Peru|President]] [[Francisco Sagasti]] becomes the first person to get vaccinated. [https://www.voanews.com/covid-19-pandemic/peru-launches-vaccination-program-against-covid-19 (Voice of America)]

'''International relations'''
*Five countries: [[Palau]], the [[Federated States of Micronesia]], the [[Marshall Islands]], [[Kiribati]] and [[Nauru]], officially withdraw from the [[Pacific Islands Forum]] over a disagreement regarding the choice of the forum's new Secretary-General. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/feb/09/pacific-islands-forum-in-crisis-as-one-third-of-member-nations-quit (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020–2021 Indian farmers' protest]]
**[[Indian people|Indian]] actor and activist [[Deep Sidhu]] is arrested by the [[Delhi Police]]'s special cell unit for his role in inciting the [[2021 Indian farmers' Republic Day protest|January 26 riot]] at the [[Red Fort]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/delhi-police-arrest-red-fort-raider-deep-sidhu/articleshow/80759496.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*[[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]]
**[[George Floyd protests]], [[George Floyd protests in Richmond, Virginia]]
***A [[Ku Klux Klan]] member is sentenced to three years and eight months in prison for driving his [[pickup truck]] into [[Black Lives Matter]] protesters in [[Richmond, Virginia]], during the summer. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/kkk-leader-sentenced-driving-through-protesters/2021/02/09/74a81bc8-6b1f-11eb-9ead-673168d5b874_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Second impeachment trial of Donald Trump]]
**Former [[President of the United States|United States president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s second [[impeachment]] trial begins. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKBN2A91D3 (Reuters)]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 56–44 to proceed with the impeachment trial, rejecting claims by Trump's attorneys that the proceeding is unconstitutional. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2021/0209/1195910-trump-impeachment/ (RTÉ)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
**A court in [[Baden-Württemberg]] overturns the nighttime curfew imposed since mid-December to stop the spread of COVID-19 following an emergency application. It means that the 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. curfew will be scrapped on February 11. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/02/09/covid-19-court-in-german-state-overturns-nationwide-nighttime-curfew (Euronews)]
*[[Mass media in Hungary]]
**A court in [[Budapest]] rejects an appeal by [[independent radio]] station [[Klubrádió]] to have its [[broadcast license]] renewed by the [[Government of Hungary|government]]'s [[Media regulation|media regulator]], which says that the station had infringed rules. Klubrádió owner András Arató says that the station will appeal the decision at the [[Supreme Court of Hungary|Supreme Court]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/top-hungary-independent-radio-forced-off-air-station-head-01612874403?tesla=y (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Buffalo, Minnesota clinic attack]]
**One person is killed and four others injured in a [[mass shooting]] at an [[Allina Health]] clinic in [[Buffalo, Minnesota]]. A 67-year-old man is arrested, and the clinic is believed to have been intentionally targeted. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/09/us/buffalo-minnesota-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]], aftermath of the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[Demonstration (political)|Demonstrations]] in [[Myanmar]]'s capital [[Naypyidaw]], continue in response to the [[Tatmadaw|military]] [[coup]]. [[Myanmar Police Force|Riot police]] fire [[rubber bullet]]s and use [[water cannon]]s to disperse protesters. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-55991210 (BBC News)]
**90 townships in 30 cities, including [[Naypyidaw]] and all 44 townships in [[Yangon]], are placed under curfew from 8:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m. local time and all gatherings of more than five people are banned. [https://www.mmtimes.com/news/90-townships-30-cities-across-myanmar-under-curfew-order.html (''Myanmar Times'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[Parliament of Ghana|Parliament]] suspends their sittings for the next three weeks after 17 [[Member of Parliament|MP]]s and 151 staff tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.pulse.com.gh/news/local/parliament-suspends-sitting-for-three-weeks-as-17-mps-test-positive-for-covid-19/d8lcyjt.amp (Pulse Ghana)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Emirates Mars Mission]]
**[[United Arab Emirates Space Agency]] [[spacecraft]] ''Hope'' [[Orbit insertion|enters orbit]] around [[Mars]]. The space probe will study the [[climate of Mars]], and meteorological phenomena such as [[dust storm]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-emirates-mars/uaes-hope-probe-enters-orbit-in-first-arab-mars-mission-idUSKBN2A91IQ?il=0 (Reuters)]
